# spotlight_workspace (Data Source)

A Spotlight workspace, read by its slug, for configuration that works inside a workspace without managing the workspace itself.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "spotlight_workspace" "acme" {
  slug = "acme"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Where the workspace lives in the web app, as in `acme`.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Names the workspace, as in `acme`.
- `id` (String) The id Spotlight issued the workspace.
- `name` (String) What the workspace is called.
